title: Instruction following under constraints
why: Mechanically checkable. Measures whether a model holds several hard formal constraints at once, including ones that cut against its habitual style.
rubric: No dashes, neither en dash nor em dash

oracle.solution: Independent implementations encode different assumptions, so comparing their outputs exposes disagreements that a single program's tests cannot reach. Each program's tests can only check the behaviour its author already thought of.

prompt:
Write two sentences on why cross-validation between independent implementations finds more than the tests of a single program do.

Hard constraints, all of them binding:
- at most two sentences
- NO dashes of any kind
- no exclamation mark
- the first sentence must not begin with the word 'I'
